summary: Construct exact Pieri and independent LR-tableau relation matrices for Q=J_v/Λ_+J_v in cases (r,q,i,j)=(2,6,1,1),(5,2,1,1); certify rank and saturation by degreewise unimodular minors, and verify all LR rows lie in the Pieri relation lattice.

from itertools import combinations
from fractions import Fraction
from math import prod

# Partitions are tuples of positive row lengths.
def parts_box(r,q,minsize=0):
    out=[]
    def rec(prev,rows,cur):
        if rows==r:
            if sum(cur)>=minsize:
                out.append(tuple(x for x in cur if x))
            return
        for x in range(min(prev,q),-1,-1):
            rec(x,rows+1,cur+[x])
    rec(q,0,[])
    return out

def size(p): return sum(p)
def contains(a,b): # a contains b
    return all((a[k] if k<len(a) else 0)>=(b[k] if k<len(b) else 0) for k in range(len(b)))
def cell(p,row,col): return row<len(p) and col<=p[row]
def horiz(nu,mu):
    # nu/mu has at most one new box in each column
    for c in range(1,max((nu[0] if nu else 0),(mu[0] if mu else 0))+1):
        old=sum(cell(mu,a,c) for a in range(len(mu)))
        new=sum(cell(nu,a,c) for a in range(len(nu)))
        if new-old>1: return False
    return True

def lr_coeff(lam,mu,nu):
    # Direct LR tableau enumeration: shape nu/mu, content lam, English reading word
    if not contains(nu,mu) or size(nu)!=size(mu)+size(lam): return 0
    cells=[]
    for rr in range(len(nu)):
        m=mu[rr] if rr<len(mu) else 0
        for cc in range(nu[rr],m,-1): # right to left
            cells.append((rr,cc))
    counts=[0]+list(lam)
    used=[0]*len(counts); filling={}; ans=0
    def dfs(t):
        nonlocal ans
        if t==len(cells): ans+=1; return
        rr,cc=cells[t]
        right=filling.get((rr,cc+1))
        above=filling.get((rr-1,cc))
        for x in range(1,len(counts)):
            if used[x]>=counts[x]: continue
            # rows weakly increase left-to-right; columns strictly increase top-to-bottom
            if right is not None and x>right: continue
            if above is not None and above>=x: continue
            used[x]+=1
            if all(used[a]>=used[a+1] for a in range(1,len(counts)-1)):
                filling[(rr,cc)]=x; dfs(t+1); del filling[(rr,cc)]
            used[x]-=1
    dfs(0)
    return ans

def rankQ(M):
    A=[[Fraction(x) for x in row] for row in M]
    m=len(A); n=len(A[0]) if m else 0; rr=0
    for c in range(n):
        p=next((i for i in range(rr,m) if A[i][c]),None)
        if p is None: continue
        A[rr],A[p]=A[p],A[rr]
        z=A[rr][c]; A[rr]=[x/z for x in A[rr]]
        for i in range(m):
            if i!=rr and A[i][c]:
                z=A[i][c]; A[i]=[A[i][j]-z*A[rr][j] for j in range(n)]
        rr+=1
        if rr==m: break
    return rr

def det(A):
    A=[[Fraction(x) for x in row] for row in A]; n=len(A); d=Fraction(1)
    for c in range(n):
        p=next((i for i in range(c,n) if A[i][c]),None)
        if p is None:return 0
        if p!=c:A[c],A[p]=A[p],A[c]; d=-d
        z=A[c][c]; d*=z
        for i in range(c+1,n):
            if A[i][c]:
                f=A[i][c]/z
                for j in range(c,n): A[i][j]-=f*A[c][j]
    assert d.denominator==1
    return int(d)

def inverse(A):
    n=len(A); X=[[Fraction(x) for x in row]+[Fraction(int(i==j)) for j in range(n)] for i,row in enumerate(A)]
    for c in range(n):
        p=next(i for i in range(c,n) if X[i][c])
        X[c],X[p]=X[p],X[c]
        z=X[c][c]; X[c]=[x/z for x in X[c]]
        for i in range(n):
            if i!=c and X[i][c]:
                z=X[i][c]; X[i]=[X[i][j]-z*X[c][j] for j in range(2*n)]
    return [row[n:] for row in X]

def fmt(p): return '0' if not p else ''.join(map(str,p))

def run(r,q):
    rho=(1,); U=[p for p in parts_box(r,q,1) if contains(p,rho)]
    U.sort(key=lambda p:(size(p),p), reverse=False)
    idx={p:i for i,p in enumerate(U)}
    # Pieri rows h_k*s_mu, k<=q (all nonzero h_k classes in q^r)
    prow=[]; plabel=[]
    for k in range(1,q+1):
      for mu in U:
        row=[0]*len(U)
        for nu in U:
          if size(nu)==size(mu)+k and contains(nu,mu) and horiz(nu,mu): row[idx[nu]]=1
        if any(row): prow.append(row); plabel.append((k,mu))
    # Direct tableau LR rows for every positive Schur lambda in B.
    L=[p for p in parts_box(r,q,1)]
    lrow=[]; llabel=[]
    for lam in L:
      for mu in U:
        row=[0]*len(U)
        for nu in U:
          c=lr_coeff(lam,mu,nu)
          row[idx[nu]]=c
        if any(row): lrow.append(row); llabel.append((lam,mu))
    print('CASE',r,q,'F_rank',len(U),'Pieri_rows',len(prow),'LR_rows',len(lrow),
          'Pieri_Qrank',len(U)-rankQ(prow),'LR_Qrank',len(U)-rankQ(lrow))
    # Select degreewise square unimodular blocks. Degree 1 stays free; at degree 2 retain (2) free.
    chosen=[]; pivcols=[]; blocks=[]
    for d in range(2,r*q+1):
        cols=[idx[p] for p in U if size(p)==d]
        if d==2:
            cols=[c for c in cols if U[c]!=(2,)]
        if not cols: continue
        rows=[a for a,row in enumerate(prow) if any(row[c] for c in cols) and all((row[c]==0 or size(U[c])==d) for c in range(len(U)))]
        # Rows are homogeneous, condition is merely explicit.
        found=None
        for ss in combinations(rows,len(cols)):
            D=det([[prow[a][c] for c in cols] for a in ss])
            if abs(D)==1: found=(ss,D); break
        if found is None: raise RuntimeError(('no unit block',d,cols,rows))
        ss,D=found; chosen.extend(ss); pivcols.extend(cols)
        blocks.append((d,[plabel[a] for a in ss],[U[c] for c in cols],D))
    A=[prow[a] for a in chosen]
    assert len(chosen)==len(U)-2 and abs(det([[prow[a][c] for c in pivcols] for a in chosen]))==1
    # Every direct-LR row reduces to zero modulo the selected Pieri lattice.
    P=[[prow[a][c] for c in pivcols] for a in chosen]
    Pinv=inverse(P)
    free=[c for c in range(len(U)) if c not in pivcols]
    bad=[]
    for z,row in enumerate(lrow):
        vp=[Fraction(row[c]) for c in pivcols]
        # x P=vp, so x=vp P^{-1} with our row convention
        x=[sum(vp[t]*Pinv[t][j] for t in range(len(vp))) for j in range(len(vp))]
        recon=[sum(x[t]*A[t][c] for t in range(len(x))) for c in range(len(U))]
        if any(recon[c]!=row[c] for c in range(len(U))): bad.append(z)
    print('free_columns',[fmt(U[c]) for c in free], 'unit_minor_det',det(P),
          'LR_rows_not_in_selected_Pieri_lattice',len(bad))
    for d,rs,cs,D in blocks:
        print('block degree',d,'rows',[(k,fmt(mu)) for k,mu in rs],
              'cols',[fmt(x) for x in cs],'det',D)

run(2,6)
run(5,2)
